messages:
lana: FYI i'm planning an RBAC refactor for Console tomorrow morning — splitting current 'editor' into 'editor' (content edits) and 'maintainer' (infra/KMS/integrations). need quick decisions on UI gating, audit logging shape, and KMS rotate permissions. anyone object?

sam: what's the concrete semantic change between editor and maintainer?

lana: editor keeps things like routes, prompts, datasets. maintainer gets infra controls: change dedicated pools, manage integrations, rotate KMS keys, update infra configs. proposed permission names: manage_kms, rotate_kms, manage_integrations, infra_write. we add an explicit permissions array to role bindings.

priya: from audit/compliance perspective we need role changes and KMS ops to emit structured audit events with these fields: actor_id, actor_email, role_before, role_after, resource_id, action, source_ip, request_id, timestamp. also retention for those logs >=90 days, and an alert on any rotate_kms by non-privileged accounts.

dylan: UI gating: hide sensitive infra controls unless has manage_kms OR is admin. prefer showing disabled controls with a tooltip: 'You need maintainer role to perform this — request access' so users know how to proceed. do we want to expose a request flow?

lana: yes, show disabled + CTA to request role. support can approve; we should record the request in audit and in an admin review queue.

sam: note: current frontend only checks `can_edit` boolean. we'll need to change checks to inspect a permissions array (e.g., permissions.includes('rotate_kms')). this will touch several components in Console.

jess: devex note — API change required. /v1/projects/:id/roles will return `permissions: [string]` per binding. also SDK helpers need update: `client.hasPermission(projectId, 'rotate_kms')`.

lana: example role payload i plan to add to the migration job:
```json
{
  "role": "maintainer",
  "permissions": ["project.read","project.write","manage_kms","rotate_kms","manage_integrations"]
}
```

lana: rollout plan: 1) migration job mapping existing editor bindings -> editor (no manage_kms) + maintainer flag=false; 2) enable new schema but keep current bindings unchanged; 3) canary: 5% of orgs get UI check/permission enforcement; 4) monitor 403s for manage_kms with telemetry; 5) if >0.5% of active users hit regressions, rollback enforcement and iterate.

priya: security OK contingent on: - audit events including fields above - KMS operations logged to both Console audit and KMS provider logs - retention 90 days - alerting for unexpected rotations. otherwise we block.

dylan: add one extra guard: service accounts should not be allowed maintainer by default. we'll add a whitelist check and run a scan before rollout to detect SA bindings that would gain manage_kms. also remember last week's incident where a SA could rotate keys because it inherited editor — that must be covered.

jess: i'll open the API PR and SDK issue today. frontend owners: @sam can you stub gating checks so we can test canary?

sam: yep i'll add perms middleware and a feature flag. will coordinate with @jess on the new response shape.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (canary enabled for 5% orgs).

lana: assigning follow-ups: @jess (API + migration job), @sam (frontend gating + flag), @priya (audit + alerting + retention), @dylan (SA whitelist scan). i'll create GH issues and link here. thanks all. :thumbsup:

priya: quick question — how will we surface role_before/role_after in the UI for audit reviewers? need an endpoint that returns change history per project.

lana: good call — add endpoint /v1/projects/:id/audit/role-changes returning paged events. we'll include human-readable diffs.

sam: and devex: add a CLI helper `redwood roles:diff --project` that prints change pairs.

lana: ok that's enough for now. i'll post GH links once created.

sam: :thumbsup:
